payload.title: Proxy Database Comparisons
payload.description: This notebook, authored by Tanaya Gondhalekar, aims to compare proxy databases before and after interpolation to understand the differences in reconstructions. It utilizes the 'cfr' library to perform direct comparisons and identify discrepancies between interpolated and non-interpolated datasets. The analysis also includes a comparison between the original PAGES2k and PReSto2k databases, addressing challenges in matching due to naming conventions. Additionally, it examines metadata versus class-based seasonality in proxy records.
